assets.generationPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: final production transparent cabinet-surround overlay for Frontier Fortune, an original spaghetti western slot game. This is a physical hollow game cabinet prop, not a screenshot, UI mockup or picture frame illustration.
Primary request: one broad front-facing rectangular saloon slot cabinet surround, outer silhouette about 5:3 landscape. Worn nearly black walnut timber, carved heavy western woodworking, oxidized silver corner brackets with shallow engraved western scroll details, a very thin restrained aged brass inlay. Tactile cinematic hand-painted 3D game prop quality. No glossy gold border and no rounded generic UI panel.
CRITICAL OPENING: the entire large central rectangular opening must be genuinely transparent alpha, an EMPTY HOLE through which HTML reels will show. Absolutely no wood, dark panel, glass, reflection, shadow fill, backdrop or painted image inside the opening. Make the hole straight-sided and rectangular, occupying approximately x7% to x93% and y17% to y93% of the full canvas. No inner decorative flourishes protruding into this clean reel aperture. The outside of the cabinet must also be genuinely transparent.
Composition/framing: flat orthographic front view, horizontal and vertical edges parallel to canvas edges, no perspective taper. Whole outer cabinet visible with a small transparent margin, no cropping. Upper wood header is deeper than side/bottom rails, with a broad empty flat dark walnut band for an HTML title overlay. Side rails slim and bottom rail very shallow; do not add a control deck or card rack. Intended canvas around1600x960, landscape5:3.
Materials and lighting: scarred black walnut grain, rubbed tobacco-brown edges, oxidized pewter and silver, ivory pinstripe accents, hairline dull brass only; cinematic soft amber edge light from upper left, deep black-brown shadows on material only. Elegant, grimy, grounded frontier craftsmanship; believable construction and visibly physical materials.
Constraints: exactly one hollow surround; NO symbols, NO cards, NO reels, NO text or lettering, NO logo, NO gun, NO horse, NO building, NO buttons, NO meters, NO floor or scene, NO background. Preserve a large completely transparent rectangular center and transparent exterior.
